exposure: resuscitative endovascular balloon occlusion of the aorta (REBOA)
outcome: packed red blood cells required for transfusion
cohort: The study included six women scheduled for cesarean section due to placenta accreta who had REBOA devices placed.
finding: The REBOA device was found to be a safe and useful alternative for controlling massive bleeding in patients with placenta accreta during cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study's findings directly relate to the mode of birth (cesarean section), demonstrating REBOA's utility in managing bleeding during this procedure for patients with placenta accreta.
